_meta.purpose: Per-bank Integration Layer configuration. Edited via the admin Module Config Centre at the Integration Layer card.
configurable_keys: field_overrides — map operational table → staff field column when the deploying bank's CBS schema differs from A2Z defaults
active_rule_overrides — list of kpi_id strings to forcibly disable (overrides the JSON rule-set's `active` flag)
status_vocabulary — bank-specific enum lists for status values used by predicates
agent_alerts_config.role_aliases — map role-title labels in operational tables to the staff register's labels (v10.113)
agent_alerts_config.role_to_staff_code — pin a role to a specific staff_code regardless of role population (v10.113)

agent_alerts_config._meta: Per-bank role resolution for agent_fraud_alerts. role_aliases maps the table's role label to the staff-register role label (Eco Bank uses 'Manager Agency Banking' in users.json; the alerts table uses 'Agency Banking Manager'). role_to_staff_code allows admin to pin a specific staff_code regardless of register population — useful for permanent ownership.

_security._documentation: v10.120 role-gating GA. role_gating_enabled toggles POST /api/integration/run-period authorization. When True, user.role from JWT must be in allowed_roles_for_write. Defaults shipping with v10.120 reflect the canonical Eco Bank role taxonomy. Banks with different role names must update this list before enabling. Set to False to preserve v10.116-v10.119 JWT-only behavior.

_data_source._note: v10.311: first cutover toggle (compliance_regulatory_returns). v10.312: fanned out to all 5 v10.306 PG-migrated tables. All set to auto: try PG first, fall back to JSON silently. Safe when PG is unreachable. Future increment can switch to pg_view per-table once PG is populated and proven.
